about: How the tune check finds the stick inputs a rate loop can be measured on, and how it measures tracking (spec: Copter analyzers, 'Rate-loop tune'). Starting values, not yet calibrated against the fleet's logs.

excitation.about: An event is a run of samples where the axis's rate target (RATE.RDes, PDes, YDes, deg/s) is at least the threshold, runs closer than merge_s joined (the two lobes of a doublet), kept when the joined run lasts min_active_s, widened by before_s and after_s to take in the start and the settling. The thresholds sit well above the targets a steady hover makes and well below what a 40% stick input in AltHold asks for.
excitation.stick_modes_about: Modes whose sticks command lean angle or rate directly, so the rate target follows the pilot. AutoTune makes its own twitches; Loiter, PosHold and the autopilot modes shape their own targets and brake on their own.
excitation.limit_flag_about: PID Flags bit 0 (LIMIT): the controller's output is saturated and the I term's anti-windup is active, set from the motors' own limit flags (AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.cpp rate_controller_run passes _motors.limit.roll, .pitch, .yaw to AC_PID::update_all).

tracking.about: Tracking error of one event: the RMS of (target - actual) over the RMS of the target, in percent. An axis's value is the mean over its counted events, with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval over the events, seeded so every laptop gets the same interval. Below min_events counted events the value is not given: the interval would be too wide to compare flights.

sources: ArduCopter/Copter.cpp loop_rate_logging and ten_hz_logging_loop at Copter-4.7.0 (1511f27): with LOG_BITMASK bit 0 (MASK_LOG_ATTITUDE_FAST) RATE is written every loop, and PIDR, PIDP and PIDY too with bit 12 (MASK_LOG_PID); with bit 1 alone RATE is written at 10 Hz. ModeAutoTune::logs_attitude() is true, so AutoTune writes its own messages instead.
ArduCopter/rate_thread.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: with the fast rate thread, RATE and the PIDs are written at the thread's fast logging rate (up to 1 kHz) with bit 0.
libraries/AP_Logger/LogFile.cpp AP_Logger::Write_PID at 4.7.0: Flags bit 0 LIMIT (output saturated, I-term anti-windup active), bit 1 PD_SUM_LIMIT, bit 2 RESET, bit 3 I_TERM_SET.
ArduCopter/Log.cpp Log_Write_Control_Tuning at 4.7.0: CTUN.Alt is the position estimate's height above the EKF origin; heights here are taken from it relative to the moment of arming.

libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.cpp at 4.7.0: RCn_MIN 1100, RCn_TRIM 1500, RCn_MAX 1900 by default; ArduCopter/radio.cpp sets the roll and pitch dead zones to 20 and yaw's to 15 or 20. The log's own values are used; the defaults stand in only where a value is missing.
